purpose: Plan safe materialization of official Android OTA containers for camera-stack research.
rules: never flash or modify a connected device
never commit proprietary partition images or extracted vendor blobs
prefer derived path/hash/signal indexes as repository artifacts

payload_extractor.evidence_role: tooling only; never treated as source evidence

dynamic_partition_unpacker.role: split super.img into logical partition images

sparse_converter.role: convert Android sparse images to raw images when necessary
